slides: Welcome back. Now the more advanced operation questions. Each question that follows shows one type, and teaches it. First, one type that only the practice has, the inverse operation.

slides.say: The inverse operation undoes the diamond. Put in the result, and you get x back. Take diamond of x equals two x plus three. Read its steps, first times two, then plus three.
Undo them in reverse order. The last step comes off first, so minus three, and then divide by two. y minus three, over two.
Check with a number. Four goes to eleven. Eleven minus three is eight, and eight over two is four. Back to the start.
And the trap undoes the steps in the wrong order. y over two, minus three. Eleven over two is five and a half, and five and a half minus three is two and a half. Not four.

One more. Diamond of x is three x minus four. Undo, plus four, then divide by three. Five goes to eleven, and eleven plus four is fifteen, and fifteen over three is five. Back again. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next video.
